items.summary: Handoff: retain SearchWoot's private, preview-only gate. The four launch-readiness tasks remain open; Woot rights are blocked pending written permission and human-counsel review. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle only; do not send outreach or expose the product.

Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline is technical only with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow due to source permissions or collector errors; operations and security sweeps are unavailable; Amazon evidence is 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, not site-attributable. Exact decision: create no go-live proposal, keep private or preview-only properties gated, and continue only existing evidence, measurement, repair-or-close, reconciliation, and readiness work. Human counsel is required for rights-dependent commercial data use, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising expansion.

Progress: 0/4 launch-readiness tasks closed; all 4 remain open. No task may close because direct evidence is still missing for source rights, field-level use limits, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident/request inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing written permission or an API agreement and field-level rights for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table including identifiers, Slack delivery, deletion, correction, access, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed; capture deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, without enabling tracking, remarketing, or customer matching. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request inventory.

Keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unlaunched until rights, privacy, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates are complete. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. For each parked property, the next evidence action is to attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Ordinary growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. Continue existing reversible work only where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves current disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, and platform-policy boundaries. Do not claim lift from incomplete measurement or treat unavailable analytics as zero.
